chapter.heading: The Happiness of Those Whose Help Is the Lord
chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord!Praise the Lord, O my soul! [2 Kin. 25:1, 2; Jer. 39:1,]

While I
live I will praise the Lord;I will sing praises to my God while I have my being. [Neh. 3:25; Jer.]

Do not
put your trust in princes,Nor in a son of man, in whom there is no help. [Jer. 26:8, 9 d Jer.]

His spirit
departs, he returns to his earth;In that very day his plans perish. [2 Kin. 25:4-7; Jer. 34:3; 38:18, 23; 39:5; 52:9 f Jer.]

Happy is
he who has the God of Jacob for his help,Whose hope is in the Lord his God, [Jer. 27:22; 39:7; Ezek. 12:12,] [Jer. 27:22 i Jer.]

Who made
heaven and earth,The sea, and all that is in them;Who keeps truth forever,

Who executes
justice for the oppressed,Who gives food to the hungry.The Lord gives freedom to the prisoners. [Lev. 25:24, 25, 32; Ruth 4:4]

The Lord
opens the eyes of the blind;The Lord raises those who are bowed down;The Lord loves the righteous.

The Lord
watches over the strangers;He relieves the fatherless and widow;But the way of the wicked He turns upside down. [Gen. 23:16; Zech. 11:12]

The Lord
shall reign forever—Your God, O Zion, to all generations.Praise the Lord!
